title: In Paris, Grand Openings and Gourmet Meals Await
abstract: Big spaces and boldface names lead a stylish comeback for the City of Light. “We’re looking at a lovely year,” one chef says.

title: From the South Side to the Loop, Chicago’s Innovative Spirit Thrives
abstract: Theater, art and music are flourishing, and on the culinary scene, a 13-course Filipino tasting menu and a sleek Black-owned winery in Bronzeville are just a few of the city’s new offerings.

title: Summer in Copenhagen: Biking, Dining and Celebrating
abstract: Add the Tour de France — starting in Denmark’s capital this year — to the roster of summer activities, which also includes music festivals, design exhibitions and indulging in buttery pastries.

title: In New Orleans, Time-Tested Charms and Some Bright New Baubles
abstract: Immersive art, bespoke hotels and restaurants that range from Creole to a ‘tropical roadhouse’ are only a few of the offerings awaiting visitors.

title: In Athens Creativity in Art, Food and More Rises
abstract: The Greek capital has added impressive arts venues, daring restaurants and a blossoming hotel scene to its well-known Classical draws.
